en:content.blog.designing-for-clarity-in: Hello, and welcome to my blog.
This is the first post I am leaving here, and a simple beginning.
I focus on making complex tools feel calm and readable.
en:content.about.profile.md.body[1]: I care about making complex tools feel calm, clear, and easy to understand. This page records the principles I return to, while the rest of the site holds work, writing, and experiments in progress.
